title: A/P: the three aging reports are in the Reports menu with their titles
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Find the "Accounts Payable" heading under "Finance".
  3. Click "A/P Aging Summary".
  4. Read the page title and the page address.
  5. Click "A/P Aging Detail".
  6. Read the page title and the page address.
  7. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices".
  8. Read the page title and the page address.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 2:

  • the heading lists A/P Aging Summary, A/P Aging Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices.

Step 4:

  • title "A/P Aging Summary"; address ends in /reports/ap-aging-summary.

Step 6:

  • title "A/P Aging Detail"; address ends in /reports/ap-aging-detail.

Step 8:

  • title "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report"; address ends in /reports/ap-unpaid-invoices.

Why this matters: Users must still find the payables reports where they always were.
